artifact.self_contained_problem:
For integers b, c and a nonnegative integer n, define the generalized central trinomial coefficient
   T_n(b, c) = [x^n] (x^2 + b x + c)^n,
i.e., the coefficient of x^n in (x^2 + b x + c)^n. For an odd prime p and an integer a coprime to p, let (a/p) denote the Legendre symbol. Prove or disprove the following two-part conjecture.

(i) Let p > 3 be a prime. Then
   (3/p) ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(2,3)^3 / 8^k  ≡  ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(2,3)^3 / (-64)^k  ≡  ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(2,9)^3 / (-64)^k  ≡  (3/p) ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(2,9)^3 / 512^k
  ≡  { 4x^2 - 2p  (mod p^2), if p ≡ 1, 7 (mod 24) and p = x^2 + 6 y^2;
       2p - 8x^2  (mod p^2), if p ≡ 5, 11 (mod 24) and p = 2 x^2 + 3 y^2;
       0          (mod p^2), if (-6/p) = -1. }
Moreover,
   ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} (3k+2) T_k(2,3)^3 / 8^k  ≡  p ((3/p) - 1) (mod p^2),
   ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} (3k+1) T_k(2,3)^3 / (-64)^k  ≡  p (-2/p) (mod p^3).
When (-6/p) = 1,
   ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} (72k+47) T_k(2,9)^3 / (-64)^k  ≡  42 p  (mod p^2),
   ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} (72k+25) T_k(2,9)^3 / 512^k  ≡  12 p (3/p)  (mod p^2).
Also, for every positive integer n,
   ∑_{k=0}^{n-1} (3k+2) T_k(2,3)^3 · 8^{n-1-k} ≡ 0 (mod 2n),
   ∑_{k=0}^{n-1} (3k+1) T_k(2,3)^3 · (-64)^{n-1-k} ≡ 0 (mod n).

(ii) For every prime p > 3,
   (2/p) ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(18,49)^3 / 8^{3k}  ≡  ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(18,49)^3 / 16^{3k}
  ≡  { 4x^2 - 2p (mod p^2), if p ≡ 1 (mod 4) and p = x^2 + y^2 with 2 ∤ x, 2 | y;
       0 (mod p^2), if p ≡ 3 (mod 4). }
Also,
   (-1/p) ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(10,49)^3 / (-8)^{3k}  ≡  (6/p) ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k(10,49)^3 / 12^{3k}
  ≡  { 4x^2 - 2p (mod p^2), if p ≡ 1, 3 (mod 8) and p = x^2 + 2 y^2;
       0 (mod p^2), if (-2/p) = -1. }
Furthermore,
   ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} (7k+4) T_k(10,49)^3 / (-8)^{3k}  ≡  p (2/p) (65 - 9 (?/p))  (mod p^2),
   ∑_{k=0}^{p-1} (7k+3) T_k(10,49)^3 / 12^{3k}  ≡  3 p (13 + 15 (?/p))  (mod p^2),
and for every positive integer n the analogous divisibilities
   ∑_{k=0}^{n-1} (7k+4) T_k(10,49)^3 · (-8^3)^{n-1-k} ≡ 0 (mod 4n),
   ∑_{k=0}^{n-1} (7k+3) T_k(10,49)^3 · (12^3)^{n-1-k} ≡ 0 (mod n).

Determine whether all of the above congruences hold.

artifact.status_search_result: Web search shows ongoing partial progress on Z.-W. Sun's supercongruence conjectures involving generalized central trinomial coefficients T_k(b,c), with several individual congruences of this type proved by Mao, Liu, and others using WZ-pairs and hypergeometric techniques (e.g., arXiv:2003.14221, arXiv:2603.18463). However, no source verifying the full Conjecture A74 in all its parts was located, so the overall status is unknown.

status_evidence.title: On a supercongruence conjecture of Z.-W. Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a supercongruence conjectured by Z.-W. Sun involving similar combinatorial sums.
status_evidence.claim: Individual Sun-type supercongruences are being resolved one at a time.

status_evidence.title: A Generalized Supercongruence of Z.-W. Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Uses the WZ method to prove a supercongruence conjecture of Z.-W. Sun.
status_evidence.claim: Active progress on Sun's supercongruence conjectures continues, but A74 not specifically confirmed.
